data.name: Canal Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
Canal Tycoon is a historical transport management game set between 1750 and 1899, following the rise, boom and decline of Britain’s canal age.

Build a canal company from its first local routes into a regional transport network. Move coal, iron, grain, timber, food, building materials, manufactured goods, passengers and mail. Link mines, farms, factories, wharves and settlements, then keep the whole system working as the world changes around it.

The early game is about getting the basics moving. Coal needs customers. Settlements need food and fuel. Industries need reliable supply routes before they can grow.

By the mid-game, Canal Mania is under way. Expand your network, compete with rival canal companies, claim profitable routes and decide when ambitious engineering is worth the cost.

By the late game, the railways are coming. Your canal network will no longer win simply by existing. Consolidate, improve efficiency, defend your best traffic and keep your waterways profitable against faster competition.

Canals are not just transport routes. They need water. Locks consume it, reservoirs store it, feeders move it, and poor planning can leave a profitable route short of supply. Terrain, rivers, rainfall, engineering choices and water rights all affect whether your network runs smoothly or struggles.

Politics matters too. Mill owners, landowners, towns and rival interests all want a say in how water is used. Securing the right to build is only part of the challenge; keeping enough water in your canal may be just as important.

Technology changes what you can build. Early routes must work around the limits of the period. Later advances open up new solutions, including improved locks, tunnels, aqueducts, boat lifts and inclined planes.

Routes and boats run autonomously once set up, avoiding the constant vehicle management found in many transport games. The focus is on planning, expansion, water supply, industry, competition and long-term survival.

Maps are created from period map sources, giving each landscape a historical foundation. Roads, rivers, settlements, industries and terrain are based on the world canals were built through, rather than a blank sandbox.

Features

Build and manage a canal company from 1750 to 1899.

Plan canals around terrain, water supply, settlements, industries and construction cost.

Manage water using reservoirs, feeders, rivers and careful lock placement.

Handle disputes over water rights, local politics and competing interests.

Unlock new engineering options as technology advances, including tunnels, aqueducts, boat lifts and inclined planes.

Move coal, iron, grain, timber, food, building materials, manufactured goods, passengers, mail and more.

Connect farms, mines, ironworks, factories, wharves, warehouses, boatyards, villages and growing towns.

Expand during Canal Mania while competing with rival canal companies.

Buy and improve industries to strengthen your supply chains.

Set up autonomous boat routes without repetitive vehicle micromanagement.

Consolidate and optimise your network as the railways begin taking your business.

Play on maps created from period sources, with historically grounded settlements, terrain and industry placement.

Build locks, basins, wharves, warehouses, embankments, tunnels and aqueducts to overcome the landscape.

Can your canal company thrive through the golden age of waterways AND survive the arrival of the railways?

data.short_description: Canal Tycoon is a unique transport builder set in the canal’s golden age, with mechanics not seen elsewhere in the genre. Move industry’s goods across period-map landscapes, manage contested water, politics and rivals, automate operations to reduce grind, then survive the railroads.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics supported
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU not required
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible sound card
